purpose: E12B GPT-specific prompt selection; document-disjoint from TRAIN_PROMPT_v1, TRAIN_ARCH_v1 and TRAIN_ORACLE_v1
sampling_algorithm: Identical to TRAIN_PROMPT_v1/TRAIN_ARCH_v1 except the candidate pool is restricted to documents used by NONE of the three prior manifests (document-level exclusion, by construction). Per class: sort untouched doc ids, shuffle with random.Random(1200), take <=2 cases/doc until 50. Sorted by (class, doc, hyp). Performance-agnostic: no model output, difficulty, or evidence property is read.
